title: Entropic estimation of optimal transport maps
tldr_zh: 熵耦合的 barycentric projection = Id − ∇f_ε（熵版 Brenier），Sinkhorn 即可算，L² 风险率 n^{-(ᾱ+1)/(2(d+ᾱ+1))} log n
tldr_en: The barycentric projection of the entropic plan equals Id minus the gradient of the entropic potential; computable by Sinkhorn with finite-sample L2 rates.
key_numbers: Two-sample rate: E||T_hat - T_0||^2_{L2(P)} <~ (1+I_0) n^{-(abar+1)/(2(d+abar+1))} log n with eps ~ n^{-1/(d+abar+1)}, abar = min(alpha,3) (Theorem 3)
Population bias: ||T_eps - T_0||^2_{L2(P)} <~ eps^2 I_0 + eps^{(abar+1)/2} (Corollary 1, Eq. 23)
Two-sample fluctuation: E||T_{eps,(n,n)} - T_{eps,n}||^2 <~ eps^{-d/2} log(n) n^{-1/2} (Theorem 5)
Finite Sinkhorn iterations k >~ n^{7/(d+abar+1)} log n suffice; total time n^{2+o_d(1)} (Theorem 7)
GPU (KeOps) run with n=10^4, d=10 takes about 1/3 second (Sec. 7.3.3, curves only)
